result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the wide roadway and a large bush at the corner create sightline obstructions and potential for higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large, dense bush at the corner of the intersection obstructs the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching from the side street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner of the building

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, open geometry of the roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing the risk for pedestrians during the crossing phase.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove or significantly trim the large bush at the corner to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with high-visibility continental crosswalks and well-maintained sidewalks. However, the lack of a pedestrian refuge island and visible pedestrian signals creates a long, unprotected crossing for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals, but the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance for pedestrians. While sidewalks are present, the environment lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands, prioritizing vehicular throughput over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads that show the remaining time to cross safely, improving predictability for all users.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings. However, the wide roadway and faded crosswalk markings increase pedestrian exposure and reduce visibility for motorists.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, making the pedestrian crossing area less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
